title: Filtered colimits of flat modules are flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $(M_i,\varphi_{ij})$ be a filtered (directed) system of flat $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then the filtered colimit $M=\varinjlim_i M_i$, with its induced $R$-module structure, is flat over $R$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05UT (lemma-colimit-flat), line 8660: a directed colimit of flat $R$-modules is flat; proof by commutation of tensor products with colimits and exactness of directed colimits

mathlib_searches.query: filtered colimit of flat modules is flat
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.FilteredColimits.colimitModule and ModuleCat.FilteredColimits.colimitCoconeIsColimit (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.FilteredColimits) describe filtered module colimits; no theorem asserting flatness of the colimit

mathlib_searches.query: a directed colimit of flat modules over a fixed ring is flat
mathlib_searches.results: Module.Flat.directSum and Module.Flat.dfinsupp (Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.Basic) concern direct sums, while ModuleCat.FilteredColimits.colimitCoconeIsColimit only supplies the filtered colimit; no filtered-colimit flatness theorem
